name: Cedar Hollow Community Church
tagline: A country church with an open door

seo.description: Cedar Hollow Community Church on Route 000 in Cedar Hollow, NJ. Sunday worship at 10:30 AM, potluck the first Sunday of every month.

specialServices.title: Christmas Eve Candlelight Service
specialServices.note: Hot cider in the fellowship room afterward.

hero.headline: Neighbors, friends and family in Christ
hero.subhead: A small church where everybody knows your name, out on Hollow Road since 1911.

welcome.heading: Come on in
paragraphs: We're a congregation of about 70 folks from the farms and towns around Cedar Hollow. Our services are simple: old hymns and new songs, a message from the Bible and plenty of time to catch up afterward.
First Sunday of the month, stay for our potluck lunch. There's always more than enough.

story: Cedar Hollow Community Church was built by local farmers in 1911 and has been a gathering place for the community ever since: Sunday worship, weddings, funerals, 4-H meetings and the famous strawberry festival every June.
We are a Bible-believing church that welcomes everyone. Whether you've been coming for 60 years or this is your first time, you're family here.

staff.name: Pastor Dale Whitaker
staff.bio: Pastor Dale has served Cedar Hollow for 18 years. When he's not preaching, you'll find him at the hardware store or on his tractor.

staff.name: Ruth Whitaker
staff.bio: Ruth plays piano on Sundays and teaches the children's class.

visit.intro: We'd be glad to see you on Sunday. Here's what to know before you come.
visit.kids: Kids are welcome in worship, and there's a children's Sunday school class at 9:30 AM.
visit.parking: Plenty of parking in the gravel lot beside the church.
